text: 固定入力から実行・検証 周期He₂の原子間力：解析力・有限差分・BOMD接続 非対称な2原子He周期セル・局所GTH・LDA交換＋VWN5。PySCFの解析力（Gaussian基底の微分を含む）を全6座標のエネルギー有限差分とDFTK平面波参照で照合し、力の基底・k点・SCF・FFT収束を分離。BOMDの力供給と短い刻み比較に限定し、長時間NVE・CPMD・一般物質は未検証。 非対称な2原子He周期セル・局所GTH・LDA交換＋VWN5。PySCFの解析力（Gaussian基底の微分を含む）を全6座標のエネルギー有限差分とDFTK平面波参照で照合し、力の基底・k点・SCF・FFT収束を分離。BOMDの力供給と短い刻み比較に限定し、長時間NVE・CPMD・一般物質は未検証。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提固定した非対称2原子Heセル（5 bohr立方、4価電子、非偏極・整数占有、局所GTH、LDA_X＋VWN5）。PySCFライブラリを使う検証ドライバー。物理的な平衡He物質や長時間MDではありません。単位原子単位：エネルギー hartree/cell、力 hartree/bohr、核座標 bohr、質量 電子質量、時間 periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated. Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated. Methods, equations, figures and references AssumptionsFixed asymmetric two-He cell (5-bohr cubic lattice, four valence electrons, unpolarized integer occupations, local GTH and LDA_X plus VWN5). A library-backed PySCF validation driver; not physical equilibrium helium or long-time MD.UnitsAtomic units: energy hartree/cell, force hartree/bohr, coordinates bohr, masses electron masses and atomic time.Boundaries and model scopeThree-dimensional Bloch periodic boundaries. Two He atoms and four valence electrons per neutral cell. Cartesian derivatives of the total energy including ionic Ewald interactions.
